[[File:Sensor_scrambler.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A sensor scrambler mounted on a Mobile Defense Unit.]]
A '''sensor scrambler''' was a type of turret found on [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] [[Mobile Defense Unit]]s. A scrambler jammed enemy missiles from hitting their target, and it also hid a number of units from enemy radar if they were within a specific radius of the scrambler.
